title: REMOVE CYLINDER HEAD BOLTS / REMOVE CYLINDER HEAD / DISASSEMBLY OF CYLINDER HEAD

content.description: Cylinder head bolt removal sequence diagram showing numbered positions 1-14 arranged in a specific pattern on the cylinder head. Numbers are arranged in two rows with positions marked.

content.text: Using SST, remove the fourteen head bolts gradually in two or three passes and in the numerical order shown.
Head warpage or cracking could result from removing in incorrect order.

content.description: Illustration showing cylinder head being lifted from cylinder block with dowels visible

content.text: Lift the cylinder head from the dowels on the cylinder block and place the head on wooden blocks on a bench.
If the cylinder head is difficult to lift off, pry with a screwdriver between the head and block saliences.
Be careful not to damage the cylinder head and block surfaces on the cylinder head gasket side.

content.description: Detailed diagram of cylinder head showing numbered positions (1s through 13s) for various components, with intake and exhaust sides labeled

content.text: Remove the two cylinder head covers by loosening the screws.
2. REMOVE NO. 1 AND NO. 2 CAMSHAFT HOUSINGS WITH CAMSHAFT
Remove No. 1 and No. 2 camshaft housings by loosening the nuts from side end nut.
Loosen each camshaft housing nut and bolt a little at a time in the sequence shown in the figure.

content.description: Diagram showing rocker arms and lash adjusters with labels pointing to specific components

content.text: 3. REMOVE ROCKER ARMS AND LASH ADJUSTERS
Remove the rocker arms and lash adjusters from the cylinder head.
Arrange the rocker arms and lash adjusters in order.

content.description: Illustration showing valve spring compression using SST tool to remove valve keepers

items: (a) Using SST, compress the valve spring until the two keepers can be removed.
